en.t: The opportunity had slipped far away.

units.source_text: 到现在才来抓住那种可能性，那就只有被自身的毒所折磨了。

en.t: To try to seize that possibility only now would mean nothing but being tormented by his own poison.

units.source_text: 眼下已经不能再等待有人会来帮忙开门了，只有自己撬开门，奋力出逃，这一条路可走。

en.t: At this point he could no longer wait for someone to come and open the door for him; the only path left was to pry it open himself and escape with all his strength.

units.source_text: 任何犹豫不决都成不了借口。

en.t: No hesitation or indecision could serve as an excuse.
